rounds.summary: Critical regression found and fixed: spawnFloor1HarvestableNodes iterated the full HARVESTABLE_DEFS array (0..length-1) which, after adding Floor 2 defs at indices 6-8, would spawn iron-vein, copper-seam, and gem-cluster nodes on Floor 1. Fixed by: (1) exporting FLOOR2_HARVESTABLE_START_INDEX=6 from harvestableDefs.ts as a shared boundary constant, (2) capping the Floor 1 spawner loop at defIndex < FLOOR2_HARVESTABLE_START_INDEX, (3) removing the redundant local re-declaration of FLOOR2_HARVESTABLE_START_INDEX from floor2Scenario.ts and importing the shared one, (4) adding a regression test asserting Floor 1 scenario produces zero nodes with defIndex>=6. No further concerns raised.

Round 2 PR review by copilot-pull-request-reviewer raised 10 concerns: (1) missing harvestable brief IDs — fixed, iron-vein-v1/copper-seam-v1/gem-cluster-v1 added to GENERATED_BRIEF_BY_HARVESTABLE; (2) itemArtIdentitySet incorrectly excluding Floor-2 item IDs — fixed, exclusion now only applies when id===itemId; (3) harvest duration floating-point — fixed with +1 tick buffer test; (4) prop sprites not in manifest — acknowledged as placeholder sprites pending art pipeline; (5) animation flags have no runtime consumer — fixed, wall-lantern-cave changed to isAnimated:false; (6) colorHex dead data — fixed, colorHex wired through LightSource and lightSources array in MainGameScene; (7) Floor-2 open-ended registry coupling — fixed, FLOOR2_HARVESTABLE_END_INDEX=9 added; (8) biomeTag test weak — fixed, test now verifies per-entity biomeTag via DECORATION_INDEX_TO_ID; (9) review ledger plan-review gap — corrected in this update; (10) handoff missing artifact evidence — added headless test results.
